name: sol-advisor
description: Configurable architect workflow with schema-v2 four-role routing, observed runtime evidence, explicit opt-in GPT-5.6 Luna app tasks, and Terra/Sol compatibility aliases.

interface.shortDescription: Route work with saved roles plus observed runtime proof, or explicitly opt into Luna tasks.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor v0.6 stores non-secret schema-v2 roles, previews four native role files, and resolves routine, medium, hard, planning, and review routes only when configured and observed runtime evidence agree. Fast is an explicit bounded Luna/Max routine override. Terra implementer and Sol reviewer remain compatibility aliases. The explicit Luna task lane uses list_projects, list_threads, create_thread, wait_threads, read_thread, and send_message_to_thread.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor's native lane to build this feature, verify it, and obtain the fresh Sol review before completion.
Use the Luna task lane only if I explicitly authorize it; create visible GPT-5.6 Luna / Max tasks via Codex app tools.
